input.summary:
Ikeja Depot Shop — Dairy Chiller, audit confidence 0.88 (trustworthy), compliance 83%, planogram share 100%, no unknown products.

Findings: 5 of 6 planogram SKUs at full expected facings. Cowbell Milk Sachet 12g (expected 3, min 1) is stocked out. Telemetry shows the chiller above 8°C for 40 minutes with a peak of 11.2°C, and the auditor flagged a fault.

Actions taken:
1. Technician dispatch proposed at HIGH urgency for the chiller temperature excursion (est. ₦15,000). Dairy product inside is at spoilage risk — staff should relocate stock to a working chiller now.
2. Cowbell Milk Sachet 12g: 6 units on hand, which equals the reorder point of 6. Shelf refill is needed immediately from that back stock (covers all 3 facings), and because stock sits at the reorder point, 2 cases (24 units, case size 12) were proposed to reach the 9-unit shelf target plus the 6-unit reorder point (est. ₦1,200).
3. Manager notified by WhatsApp covering both the fridge fault and the refill/reorder.

No orders placed for SKUs already at full facings; nothing ordered outside the planogram.
